info.name: Acadmate - Admin API
info.description: Admin endpoints (specs 30-37). Run 'Auth > Login as admin' first (Jordan Lee). Data-changing requests alter the demo data; reset with `python reset_db.py --yes && python seed_data.py`.

request.description: mail needs an SMTP body: {host, port, username, password, from, tls}. gcal/outlook return an OAuth URL.
Sends a test email first; 400 SMTP_FAILED if it can't.
Needs the csv integration connected. Headers: enrollments = student_email,course_code,term,status; grades = student_email,course_code,term,grade,grade_points.
For csv this re-runs the latest import, so run 'Import CSV' first.
Uses the Bearer key from 'Create API key' instead of the cookie.
Run Connect again afterwards: CSV imports need the csv integration connected.
